site.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
site.desc: Index case (Dutch male, 70, died 11 Apr) took 4-month road trip 27 Nov 2025–1 Apr 2026 through Chile, Uruguay, Argentina before boarding; Dutch couple believed to have contracted virus during South America visit pre-boarding per AP 13 May. Genetic analysis (AP News, 16 May; El País, 11 May) confirms Andes strain matches known South American strains with no new mutations indicating increased transmissibility or severity; Malbrán Institute trapping/testing rodents along route.

site.name: PARIS / LE BOURGET
site.desc: France confirmed first hantavirus case (Le Monde, 11 May): one of five repatriated Hondius passengers tested PCR-positive; critically ill French woman on ECMO artificial lung at Bichat Hospital Paris. AP News (16 May) confirms Andes virus detected matches known South American strains with no new mutations; French government mandated 42-day quarantine with 22 potential contact cases identified across international flights.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: 18 American passengers coordinated to Offutt AFB and transferred to National Quarantine Center at UNMC per AP 13 May; 15 quarantined at NQU including content creator Jake Rosmarin (asymptomatic, 42-day quarantine). Dr. Stephen Kornfeld (Oregon oncologist), the only American placed in biocontainment isolation, was released 14 May after inconclusive swabs resolved negative per AP 14 May. CDC confirmed no US cases resulting from this outbreak per CDC Newsroom 08 May.
